Jalen Duren will be suspended for two games. Moussa Diabate and Miles Bridges, who later took a shot at Stewart on social media , were given four. And as for Isaiah Stewart? Silver gave him a seven-game suspension for his actions. Was that enough? Apparently, Stewart‚Äôs time off the court is being compared to another former Pistons enforcer, Ben Wallace.
